1.name: Rage
1.notes:
You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, granting extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter a Rage as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You can enter your Rage a number of times equal to the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

While active, your Rage grants the following benefits:
Damage Resistance. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Rage Damage. When you make an attack using Strength with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you add a bonus that increases as you gain levels.
Strength Advantage. You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
No Concentration or Spells. You cannot maintain Concentration or cast spells.

Duration. Rage lasts until the end of your next turn. It ends early if you don Heavy armor or become Incapacitated. On each subsequent turn, you may extend your Rage to the end of your next turn by making an attack roll against an enemy, forcing an enemy to make a saving throw, or taking a Bonus Action to extend your Rage. A Rage can last up to 10 minutes.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.notes: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.notes: You can use the mastery properties of two Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of your chosen weapons. You gain additional mastery choices at higher Barbarian levels.

2.name: Danger Sense
2.notes: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see. You do not gain this benefit if you are Incapacitated.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.notes: When you make your first attack on your turn, you can attack recklessly, granting Advantage on Strength-based attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Attack rolls against you have Advantage for the same duration.

3.name: Primal Knowledge
3.notes: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Barbarian’s level 1 skill list. In addition, while your Rage is active, you can use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks instead of their normal ability.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.notes: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Fast Movement
5.notes: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing Heavy armor.

7.name: Feral Instinct
7.notes: Your instincts are honed to a supernatural degree. You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

7.name: Instinctive Pounce
7.notes: As part of the Bonus Action used to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

9.name: Brutal Strike
9.notes:
If you use Reckless Attack, you may forgo Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll on your turn. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 1d10 damage of the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike. You also choose one of the following effects:

Forceful Blow. The target is pushed 15 feet straight away, and you may move up to half your Speed directly toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Hamstring Blow. The target’s Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A creature can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time.

11.name: Relentless Rage
11.notes: If you drop to 0 Hit Points while raging and do not die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, your Hit Points become equal to twice your Barbarian level instead. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. After a Short or Long Rest, the DC resets to 10.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

13.name: Improved Brutal Strike
13.notes:
You unlock additional Brutal Strike effects:

Staggering Blow. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw and cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.

Sundering Blow. Before the start of your next turn, the next attack roll made by another creature against the target gains a +5 bonus. A creature can benefit from only one Sundering Blow at a time.

15.name: Persistent Rage
15.notes:
When you roll Initiative, you regain all expended uses of Rage. You cannot regain uses this way again until you finish a Long Rest.

Your Rage now lasts the full 10 minutes without requiring extension each round, ending early only if you fall Unconscious or don Heavy armor.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

17.name: Improved Brutal Strike
17.notes: The damage bonus of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10, and you may apply two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use the feature.

18.name: Indomitable Might
18.notes: If the total of a Strength check or saving throw is less than your Strength score, you may use your Strength score instead.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.notes: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

20.name: Primal Champion
20.notes: Your Strength score and Constitution score each increase by 4, up to a maximum of 25.
